description: List the workspace's email configurations: id, name, slug, description, provider, sender, default and active flags, and how many recipients each has. Pass an `id` as a form's `emailConfigurationId` in create_form or update_form. API keys, SMTP and Mailgun settings and recipient addresses are never returned here.

includeInactive.description: Also return inactive configurations. Only an active one sends email, so leave this off when choosing one for a form.

name: list_email_configurations
title: List email configurations
